name: ANSI/IEEE chassis ground symbol
summary: IEEE-oriented chassis or frame ground drawn as a line ending in angled strokes, used for equipment frame returns.
description: US-practice electronics and control schematics show chassis ground as a line ending in a horizontal bar with angled strokes beneath it. It identifies a connection to the equipment frame and is often used for screen terminations and filter returns inside an enclosure.

This illustration is an independent explanation, not the IEEE graphic. As with the IEC frame connection, chassis ground is not proof that the frame is connected to earth ground. Safety grounding should be shown with the protective ground symbol.
readingNotes: Do not treat chassis ground as earth ground without a separate bond.
Look for screen terminations on chassis grounds.
drawingChecklist: Show the bond between chassis and earth ground.
Keep chassis and signal commons distinct.
distinction: Chassis ground ties to the frame; earth ground ties to the grounding electrode system.
